name: get_hint
description: Reveal the next rung of the hint ladder for the current attempt: 1 nudge, 2 hint, 3 key step, 4 worked example, 5 answer. Call only after the learner has attempted and is stuck, one rung per call. Returns rung, text and is_answer; when text is null, follow the instruction field instead.

attempt_id.description: The attempt_id returned by get_next_question for the current question.
